name: Shrouded in Your Love
source:
Your boyfriend is dead or at the very least missing..? Why else has he been gone for the past two months? Everyone around you is pretty happy about this, especially since they think he's a bum who leeches off your energy. You on the other hand, are not happy about this and you want him back. In a way, you might just get your wish?

[From [url=https://whatdoinamemyself.itch.io/shrouded-in-your-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的男朋友死了或者至少失踪了..？不然他怎么这两个月不见了？你周围的每个人都对此感到非常高兴，尤其是因为他们认为他是一个汲取你能量的流浪汉。另一方面，你对此并不满意，你希望他回来。在某种程度上，你可能会实现你的愿望？

[来自[url=https://whatdoinamemyself.itch.io/shrouded-in-your-love]itch.io[/url]]
